create_PhiConfig: create a PhiConfig instance to initialize a Phi model with custom hyperparameters
build_PhiConfig_from_pretrained: build a PhiConfig by loading configuration from microsoft/phi-1 pretrained checkpoint
configure_PhiConfig_parameters: configure PhiConfig with custom vocab_size, hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and attention_heads
review_PhiConfig_qk_layernorm: review PhiConfig qk_layernorm parameter for normalizing Queries and Keys after projection
summarize_PhiConfig_defaults: summarize PhiConfig default values including vocab_size 51200, hidden_size 2048, and num_hidden_layers 24
